free-text.render_probe: Text is visible with intended box/callout geometry.
free-text.edit_probe: Viewer exposes a native FreeText annotation and permits a normal text/style edit.

notes-review.render_probe: Note/comment marker and contents are visible.
notes-review.edit_probe: Viewer exposes a native note/comment object and permits content/review interaction.

text-markup.render_probe: Markup follows the intended quadrilateral region.
text-markup.edit_probe: Viewer exposes native text-markup selection and permits a normal style/delete edit.

shapes.render_probe: Shape geometry, stroke/fill, and cloudy border where applicable are visible.
shapes.edit_probe: Viewer exposes a native shape annotation and permits a normal geometry/style edit.

linework.render_probe: Line geometry and endpoint style are visible.
linework.edit_probe: Viewer exposes a native line annotation and permits a normal geometry/style edit.

ink.render_probe: Ink strokes are visible in the intended geometry.
ink.edit_probe: Viewer exposes a native ink annotation and permits selection/delete or supported style editing.

stamp-mask.render_probe: Stamp or visual redaction-mask appearance is visible.
stamp-mask.edit_probe: Viewer exposes the managed annotation as a native selectable annotation object.

baseline.claim: Current qualification baseline intentionally contains no production /AP streams.

evidence_contract.qualification_rule: Every declared viewer/type and viewer/interoperability-journey record must exist with render=PASS and durable evidence. Native interaction/edit/save/reopen may be PASS or explicitly UNSUPPORTED. FAIL or NOT_RUN never qualifies. Journey edit/save/reopen=PASS additionally requires external_mutation=PASS and return_semantics=PASS; unsupported editing requires external_mutation=UNSUPPORTED and return_semantics=UNSUPPORTED.

review-round-trip.fixture: highlight + comment + reply + resolved review state
required_initial_graph: reply Text annotation linked to comment root via IRT and RT=R
review-state Text annotation linked to comment root via IRT with StateModel=Review
review-round-trip.render_probe: Highlight and comment/reply/review state are visibly represented without hidden flattening.
review-round-trip.native_interaction_probe: Where the viewer exposes annotation interaction, highlight and comment remain native/selectable objects and reply/review state is discoverable as supported by that viewer.
review-round-trip.edit_save_reopen_probe: Where annotation editing is supported, edit the review work, save normally, close/reopen, and verify the edited work remains native.
review-round-trip.return_probe: After an external save where supported, reopen in PDF Hub and verify root/reply identity, review state, geometry/content, nested reply parentReplyId/IRT topology, and no duplication before another PDF Hub save.
review-round-trip.required_external_mutation: For edit-capable viewers, perform at least one detectable standards-native change: comment Contents, review State, reply Contents/author/thread membership, or highlight geometry/style represented by the production reader. Open/save without semantic mutation does not qualify.
review-round-trip.return_topology_rule: If a viewer adds or preserves reply-to-reply threading, the returned-file probe must retain each logical reply parent across two subsequent PDF Hub saves. Reply-attached state objects must remain attached to the rewritten reply and must not become the root review status.
review-round-trip.return_preservation_rule: Returned managed roots and native replies must retain externally supplied AP presence plus Subj/RC where present across two subsequent no-op PDF Hub saves. Opaque RT=R descendants remain part of the raw reply graph even when they are not representable as application replies.

rich-text-preservation.fixture: FreeText root with flat Contents plus native RC rich text and DS default style
rich-text-preservation.render_probe: The FreeText annotation renders as usable native text without flattening; viewer rendering must not require destroying RC/DS semantics.
rich-text-preservation.native_interaction_probe: Where the viewer exposes annotation interaction, the FreeText remains a native/selectable object and rich-text/default-style semantics remain inspectable or at minimum preserved in the saved PDF.
rich-text-preservation.edit_save_reopen_probe: Where rich FreeText editing is supported, edit the native rich text, keep flat Contents semantically consistent, save normally, close/reopen, and verify the annotation remains native. A viewer edit that strips RC or silently flattens the annotation is FAIL, not UNSUPPORTED.
rich-text-preservation.return_probe: After an external save where editing is supported, reopen in PDF Hub and verify RC/DS remain present, the annotation imports as NATIVE_PRESERVED_READ_ONLY, flat Contents matches the externally saved work, and two subsequent PDF Hub no-op saves preserve the returned rich semantics.
rich-text-preservation.required_external_mutation: For edit-capable viewers, perform a detectable standards-native rich-text change reflected in RC and the flat Contents counterpart; formatting changes may also alter DS. Open/save without semantic mutation does not qualify.
rich-text-preservation.return_preservation_rule: The returned-file probe requires non-empty external delta, preserves returned Contents/RC/DS and AP presence across two PDF Hub no-op saves, and rejects any fidelity-class downgrade from NATIVE_PRESERVED_READ_ONLY.

ap_activation_contract.scope_rule: An AP implementation may target only the failing annotation type/family evidenced on the exact product material. Passing or untested families remain AP-disabled.
ap_activation_contract.requalification_rule: After any AP implementation, rerun every affected viewer/type/family observation and do not carry forward prior PASS evidence.
